text:
Title is in the friend, subject to a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach age 25. Because the sister had no children at the time of the conveyance, the class of “children of my sister who reach the age of 25” remains open and can include after-born children; the deceased son never reached 25 and thus never vested, and the daughter is a potential class member if she reaches 25. Therefore, the friend holds a fee simple subject to executory limitation, with the sister’s children (those who reach 25) holding the executory interest.

CONFIDENCE: 85
